note.question: How does rural water management shape the hidden crisis?
note.overview: In rural sub-Saharan Africa, people rely on communal hand pumps for clean drinking water. These hand pumps frequently break down and require repairs. Operating under the assumption that preventive maintenance is too expensive, local nongovernmental organizations (NGOs) often face difficult decisions about where to allocate their limited resources to reduce water point downtime.
